backup_device_uuid.description: UUID of the backup device to use for snapshots.

parent_device_uuid.description: UUID of the parent device if using subvolume snapshots.

do_first_run.description: Whether to run the first backup automatically on first launch.

stop_cron_emails.description: Stop cron emails during backup operations.

count_monthly.description: Number of monthly snapshots to keep.

count_weekly.description: Number of weekly snapshots to keep.

count_daily.description: Number of daily snapshots to keep.

count_hourly.description: Number of hourly snapshots to keep.

count_boot.description: Number of boot snapshots to keep.

snapshot_size.description: Maximum size for a single snapshot (0 for unlimited).

snapshot_count.description: Maximum number of snapshots to store (0 for unlimited).

exclude.description: List of paths to exclude from backup.

exclude-apps.description: List of application-specific paths to exclude.
